faq.q: What is the origin of Leman?
faq.a: Leman is associated with Arabic. Leman is a Turkish female given name. No confident lexical sense could be established, so no meaning is asserted.

Leman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
